decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation builds directly on the firm's heat-exchanger and process-engineering knowledge, so management can read early field results and refine the product, which justifies keeping it despite limited market evidence so far.

The weir-dimensioning web tool draws on in-house engineering know-how and costs little to maintain, and as a lead-generation aid tied to core products it is likely retained, although digital tools are more easily dropped or merged.

The fouling detection system is closely related to the firm's existing heat-exchanger competence and is complemented by product A, giving strong absorptive capacity to assimilate customer feedback and improve it through own development or research cooperation.
